# graylog_event_entity_types (Data Source)

Lists Graylog event definition entity type catalogs (processor, field provider, storage handler, aggregation functions). Use this when configuring `graylog_event_definition` Dynamic attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_event_entity_types" "available" {}

output "event_processors" {
  value = data.graylog_event_entity_types.available.processor_types
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `aggregation_functions` (List of String) Aggregation functions available to aggregation-v1 configs.
- `field_provider_types` (List of String) Field provider types for event definition field_spec values.
- `processor_types` (List of String) Event definition processor/config types (e.g. aggregation-v1).
- `storage_handler_types` (List of String) Storage handler types for event definition storage entries.
